lead_fa: Unholy یک اسپک DPS دوهندی است که با بیماری‌ها و ارتش گول‌هایش بازی می‌کند؛ بیشتر آسیبش در پنجره‌های برست [[Army of the Dead]] و [[Dark Transformation]] می‌آید. در Midnight Season 2 دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Rider of the Apocalypse]] با پنجره‌های ۹۰ ثانیه‌ای و ساده‌تر، و [[San'layn]] با چرخهٔ ۴۵ ثانیه‌ای که در Mythic+ سطح بالا ترجیح دارد.

strengths: Burst: incredible amount of damage in short windows
Great survivability: many active and passive defensive abilities
Simplicity: among the simplest specializations in the game
weaknesses: Low Mobility: with Paladins, DKs are now among the slowest melee classes
Low Mythic+ utility: lacks many tools that make other classes wanted in M+
Not very engaging: simplicity can get bland quickly

season2_changes: Army of the Dead now lasts 30 seconds but no longer allows summoning more ghouls during its duration; active ghouls trigger Death Order or Epidemic Order dealing damage
Commander of the Dead no longer extends Lesser Ghoul duration with Mastery
Soul Reaper now consumes up to 3 Lesser Ghoul buff stacks instead of consuming up to 2 Putrefy charges
Lord of the Dead now summons a Lich if you have 3 or more active Magus of the Dead; combined with the Season 2 tier set this hard-locks Lord of the Dead as the primary capstone choice

hero.recommendation: Rider of the Apocalypse and San'layn both have strong niches; San'layn is a 45-second cooldown-focused tree, Rider focuses on 90-second windows.
hero.raid: Choice is less clear and fight-dependent; swap between the 45s and 90s windows depending on the boss.
hero.mplus: Higher-end Mythic+ leans towards San'layn's 45-second cycle, though it needs consistent build-up and burst; Rider is easier and less demanding.
hero.defense: San'layn's self-healing makes Unholy nearly impossible to kill; Rider provides powerful mobility tools.
hero.note: Neither disappoints even outside their strengths.

concepts: Keep Abilities on Cooldown: Unholy is burst-focused and relies on using cooldowns as often as possible; cooldown setup and execution is the highest priority.
Spend your Sudden Doom procs ASAP: Sudden Doom has many talent interactions and is the strongest non-cooldown button; spend it with Death Coil or Epidemic as quickly as possible.
Keep an eye on your Ghouls: Lesser Ghoul stacks from Festering Strike let Scourge Strike summon them; always keep stacks.
priority.resources: Runes, Runic Power, and Lesser Ghoul stacks are the three resources to manage.

rotation.opener_note: Unholy's opener is a 'nuclear launch sequence'; both heroes share the same skeleton, San'layn adds two Vampiric Strike casts.
rotation.army_details: Army of the Dead is the biggest cooldown and triggers many talents (Raise Abomination, Summon Gargoyle, Apocalypse Now). With Commander of the Dead, keep Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation in sync.

gear.gearing_rules: Follow Critical Strike >= Mastery >= Haste >> Versatility; Strength/ilvl increases are generally worth it; an on-use stat trinket is very important for a burst-focused spec. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Baleful Grave-Knight's Crucible
tier_set.pc2: Your Magus of the Dead and Lord of the Dead cast a more powerful Necrotic Bolt instead of Frostbolt, and Withering Grasp instead of Shadow Bolt.
tier_set.pc4: Necrotic Bolt's damage is increased by 130%, and Withering Grasp's damage is increased by 130%, against enemies below 35% health.
tier_set.note: Purely passive pet effect; no build or rotational changes; takes talent points you already wanted.

catalyst: Gauntlets of the Avian Sentinel (King's Rest)
crafted: Blood Knight's Warblade with Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt

notes: Critical Strike >= Mastery >= Haste >> Versatility as a rough guideline.
Do not neglect Strength: a substantial item level increase is generally worth more than optimized stats.
An on-use stat trinket is very important because Unholy is burst-focused.
Sim your character with Raidbots for exact values.

mplus.hero_note: Higher-end Mythic+ leans towards San'layn's 45-second cycle; Rider of the Apocalypse is easier and demands far less setup.
tips: Unholy lacks the utility other classes bring to M+ (low mobility, few group tools).
Night Elf Shadowmeld can enable skips; Dwarf Stoneform is a defensive boost.
On-use stat trinkets are exceptionally strong in Unholy's burst windows.
